reviews.text: After years of lower-back pain I'd written off as "just my back," I can finally sleep through the night again. I only wish I'd come in two years earlier.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Dr. Okafor actually listened. He explained what was causing my sciatica instead of just cracking my back and sending me off. Three weeks in and the leg pain is nearly gone.
reviews.author: Priya N.

reviews.text: I came in for migraines I'd had for a decade. They're not magic, but they're noticeably less frequent and far less intense. The whole office feels calm and unhurried.
reviews.author: Dana R.
